_about: Made-up direct premiums written by state and line for tests/web/combomap.test.cjs, in $M (the test multiplies by a million). Keyed by NAIC code, then year: a list of [state, line, value]. For 2025 they add up, state by state, to the by-state figures and, line by line, to the by-line figures the test uses (combination_figures.json with Rhode Island added to the target). No real company, code or figure.
